thread:
sarah: FYI customer acct: acct_0xACME says their free trial credits dropped from ~10k to 0 overnight. They attached billing screenshot and say it happened around 03:00 UTC.

jamie: Thanks — can you paste the customer id + a sample request_id if they have one? Also any recent changes to their ingest job?

sarah: acct_0xACME, their job id is sync-worker-7, they sent a screenshot with a sequence of request_ids starting with req_9f8a... can't share full customer API key.

jamie: Pulling logs now. If anyone from eng can look at our edge logs for acct_0xACME between 02:50-03:20 UTC that'd help.

marco: I grabbed the edge capture for that window. Quick summary: there was a retry storm hitting /v1/embeddings for the same set of inputs. We see many 502/504 responses from upstream at 03:01:12, 03:01:13, 03:01:14 and the customer's worker retried each failure as a brand-new request (no Idempotency-Key header). Example of repeated pattern we saw in the logs: 

```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-001",
  "input": "[...document chunk...]"
}
```

marco: Each retry had a unique request_id at our side and was billed separately. Because the client re-enqueued on any 5xx and did not dedupe, one logical work item resulted in ~6 billed requests.

jamie: That's the likely cause. Customer's scheduler (sync-worker-7) is configured to always requeue on transient errors with no backoff or idempotency token. They confirmed their job created new job rows every attempt.

anya: Billing here — we can reverse trial-credit charges if it's a clear bug and not abuse. We'll need: (1) timeline of duplicate requests (account + timestamps), (2) confirmation from the customer that these were accidental retries, and (3) approval from refunds queue. I can prepare a provisional reversal once we have that.

jamie: I'll compile logs and customer confirmation. Quick mitigation steps suggested to customer: pause sync-job, add an Idempotency-Key header (or client-side dedupe), and implement exponential backoff + jitter on 5xx. Also suggest switching to a batch-size that reduces retry fanout.

marco: On our side we should consider improving guidance in the docs: emphasize that embeddings are not deduped server-side and that idempotency headers matter for background workers. Also flag the 03:01 upstream instability for ops; the transient 502s triggered the replay.

deploy-bot: deploy of edge-retries-metric v1.4 finished at 02:45 UTC :white_check_mark:

jamie: For the refund workflow — I'll attach the sanitized log slice and the customer's statement to the refunds ticket and tag you, @anya. Estimated reclaimed credits ~9,600 tokens (customer provided sample count).

anya: Sounds good. If the refunds queue approves we'll issue a reversal and top up their trial by the same amount plus a small goodwill credit. Please confirm when logs + customer confirmation are in the ticket.

sarah: Customer paused the job and confirmed they will add idempotency keys. They also asked if we can auto-detect retry storms in the future and proactively reach out.

jamie: Filing follow-up action items: 1) Refund ticket -> billing (anya) 2) Docs update on idempotency for background jobs (marco) 3) Alerting rule to detect high-frequency identical embeddings requests per account (eng-sre)

marco: I'll take the docs + quick snippet for a recommended request pattern (example code with Idempotency-Key).

jamie: Closing this thread when refund is issued. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
